title: Accessibility
description: Tune how the site looks and moves. Your preferences stay in this browser only.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: “Colour-blind safe” swaps in a safe palette and underlines every link.

fontScale.label: Text size
fontScale.hint: Scales the whole site, not just body copy.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.hint: The water drop only shows up with a mouse or trackpad.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Also updates the page's lang attribute for screen readers.

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.hint: Strengthens text, hairlines and the keyboard focus ring.

underlineLinks.label: Underline links
underlineLinks.hint: So a link never depends on colour alone.

readableSpacing.label: Reading spacing
readableSpacing.hint: More line height and more room between letters and words.
